```{r}
Pass=data$Pass
Hours=data$Hours
p=function(x){
  1/(1+exp(x))
}
d=function(x){
  log((x)/(1-x))
}
x=Hours
plot(x,d(x))
model <- glm(Pass ~ Hours, data = data, family = binomial)
plot(model)
summary(model)

```
